title: Mission: Identify the Scene
description: Find six people and things in a new Prague scene, then ask and answer three kdo/co questions.

data.heading: Find → choose → ask → identify
data.body: In the new scene, find a target, decide whether it is a person or a thing, ask Kdo je to? or Co je to?, and answer To je… Use ten, ta, or to when you can retrieve the noun chunk.

items.en: Ask about the man, woman, or child
Ask about the dog, car, building, or object

items.say: To je muž. To je žena. To je dítě.

items.cz: To je ten pes. / ta kniha. / to auto.
items.say: To je ten pes. To je ta kniha. To je to auto.
items.en: Identify a thing with its noun cue

exercises.prompt: Find six targets in the Prague scene

data.prompt_en: Look closely. Identify six people or things without relying on English labels.
data.image_label: A Prague street café with a man, woman, child, dog, car, building, window, table, chair, book, and coffee
data.text_cz: Kdo je to? Co je to? Najděte šest věcí nebo lidí: muž, žena, dítě, pes, auto a kniha.
data.text_en: Who is that? What is that? Find six people or things: a man, woman, child, dog, car, and book.

questions.question_en: Who is standing near the center?
Who is sitting beside the table?
Who is crouching near the dog?
What is parked on the left?
What is lying on the table?

data.prompt_en: Listen for three objects and their gender cues.
data.transcript_cz: Co je to? To je ten pes. To je to auto. A to je ta kniha.

data.explanation: Dítě is a person, so ask Kdo je to? Its noun gender is neuter, but that does not change kdo.

data.explanation: The three scene nouns retrieve one masculine, one feminine, and one neuter cue.
